spans.s:
Ruru is one of the victims at the Aśvamedha (‘horse
sacrifice’) in the Yajurveda.^1 A kind of deer is meant. The
Rigveda^2 mentions ‘deer-headed’ (ruru-śīrṣan) arrows, meaning
such as have points made of deer's horn.
1) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, v. 5, 19, 1;
Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 27. 39;
Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14. 9.
2) vi. 75, 15.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 83.
